$comment: The v0.1 fixture supplied a bare {issuer, revoked_jtis, fail_mode} list; v0.2 restates it as a signed revocation snapshot (RFC-AITP-0008 §1.5) so the same input shape feeds both the rev-* snapshot path and this TCT-level lookup. The snapshot signature placeholder is __VALID_B_SIG__ (the issuing peer here is agentB / kat-keypair-002, per the PLACEHOLDERS.md AID role table). Its signing input is the JCS canonical form of the INNER `revocation_list` body; the `{"revocation_list": ..., "signature": ...}` envelope is the wire shape and is never signed (RFC-AITP-0008 §1.5, RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.1).
description: TCT compact JWS is valid and not expired, but its `jti` appears in the issuing peer's revocation list. Receivers MUST reject with TCT_REVOKED (RFC-AITP-0008; RFC-AITP-0005 §7.2 step 6 — revocation lookup runs only after all signature checks). Per the per-issuing-peer model, only the originating issuer's deny list applies.
